cli.description: Telegram media downloader with a web management UI
cli.opt.lang: Language for CLI messages (en or zh-TW)
cli.opt.home: Project directory containing .env, data/ and logs/ (default: current directory)
cli.opt.chat: Chat to download from: numeric id, @username or t.me link
cli.opt.limit: Number of most recent messages to scan
cli.cmd.serve: Start web UI, monitors and download workers (Ctrl+C to stop)
cli.cmd.fetch: One-shot: download media from the latest messages of a chat
cli.login.phone_invalid: Invalid phone number, please try again.
cli.login.code_invalid: Invalid or expired code, please try again.
cli.not_logged_in: Not logged in to Telegram. Run `tgdl login` first.
cli.password.prompt: New web admin password (at least {min} characters):
cli.password.too_short: Password must be at least {min} characters.
cli.password.done: Web admin password saved. All existing web sessions were signed out.
config.missing_api: API_ID and API_HASH must be set in .env (see .env.example).
config.bad_api_id: API_ID in .env must be a number.
config.bad_port: WEB_PORT in .env must be a number.
config.base_dir_not_absolute: ALLOWED_BASE_DIRS entry must be an absolute path: {path}
template.base_dir_position: {base_dir} may only appear at the start of the template.
template.bad_segment: Template contains an empty, '.' or '..' path segment.
template.needs_filename: The last path segment must contain {filename}.
dir.not_absolute: Directory must be an absolute path.
dir.outside_allowed: Directory is outside the allowed base directories.
cli.cmd.monitor: Manage chat monitors (list / add / remove / enable / disable)
cli.monitor.need_id: Please use the numeric chat id (see `tgdl monitor list`).
cli.monitor.done: Done. A running `tgdl serve` applies this within 30 seconds.
cli.serve.started: Running as {name}: {monitors} active monitor(s), {concurrency} worker(s). Press Ctrl+C to stop.
cli.serve.stopping: Stopping... (press Ctrl+C again to force quit)
backfill.bad_range: The start date must not be after the end date.
backfill.already_running: A backfill is already running for this chat.
backfill.not_monitored: Add the chat as a monitor before running a backfill.
